title: Clinic demo: choose the look
question: The roll picked Kashi Glaze. Keep it, take another card, or re-roll.

options.label: Kashi Glaze
options.lineage: Lahore's kashi tilework (Wazir Khan Mosque) and Mughal jali screens
options.thesis: The clinic as cool glazed tilework: every free appointment is a glazed tile you can take.
options.viewport: A jali screen frames today's free slots as glazed tiles beside the clinic name and timings; Book sits on the first free tile.
options.risk: Can read as a mosque or a restaurant if ornament outweighs the clean white glaze.

raised.raise: Solid lapis is kept for one decisive moment: the confirmed booking.
Find us draws one single route from a known landmark to the clinic door.
Slots show a ladder (free, filling, last one, full) as glaze depth, not only on or off.
Every doctor and service caption is joined to its tile by a visible grout line.
Text sits on two values only, white glaze and lapis ink, so it reads in daylight.

options.label: Parchi
options.lineage: Pakistani doctors' prescription pads and clinic token slips
options.thesis: The website as the clinic's own letterhead: booking hands you a numbered token slip.
options.viewport: The doctor's letterhead with degrees and a timings box; a token slip tears off with your booked time.
options.risk: The most familiar direction; it can feel like paperwork rather than care.

options.label: Availability Bridge
options.lineage: a recording desk's row of VU meters
options.thesis: All doctors stand side by side as a row of meters, so the whole week reads at one glance.
options.viewport: A bridge of doctor meters, each needle showing how full their day is; tap one to book.
options.case: Fuses well for clarity (availability in one sweep), but patients do not know studio desks.
options.risk: A recording studio feels cold and technical for a family clinic.

options.label: Manga Screentone
options.thesis: The clinic told in black and white panels with speed lines.
options.viewport: Panels of the patient's visit, the booking as the bleed panel.
options.case: Fuses poorly: Lahore families do not read a clinic as a comic.
options.kept: One solid fill kept only for the decisive moment.

options.label: Treasure Map
options.thesis: Finding the clinic as following a drawn route.
options.viewport: A parchment map with the route to the clinic in red.
options.case: Fuses poorly: mystery is the opposite of what a patient needs.
options.kept: One single drawn route for directions.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.thesis: Time slots orbiting a dark center.
options.viewport: Rings of slots around a black center.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dark and cosmic feels wrong for a family clinic.
options.kept: Slot states as a ladder instead of on and off.
options.risk: Dramatic and hard to read on cheap phones.

options.label: Memory Quilt
options.thesis: Doctors and services as stitched patches.
options.viewport: A patchwork of services joined by stitches.
options.case: Fuses poorly: busy patches hide timings and fees.
options.kept: Every caption visibly joined to its block.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: The clinic as barcodes and numbers.
options.viewport: A wall of bars with timings in mono.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cold and unfriendly to older patients.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean medical website, done very well.
canonCard.viewport: A smiling dentist photo, a Book Appointment button, services as icon cards.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other clinic website.
